newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria's winter tourism fails to get lift.
newsitem.headline: Austria's winter tourism fails to get lift.

text.p: Austria's tourism industry, once the mainstay of the Alpine republic's economy but in a tailspin for the past few years, received more bad news on Monday when latest figures for the winter season showed little improvement.
Overnight stays in the first three months of the season, starting in November 1996, totalled 20.47 million, unchanged from the year-ago period, the economics ministry said.
Overnight stays by foreigners inched up 0.7 percent to 16.04 million, but those by domestic tourists fell 2.4 percent to 4.43 million.
Germans, the bulwark of Austria's tourism, increased their overnight stays by 1.6 percent to 11.14 million.

In January alone, overnight stays slumped 4.9 percent to 10.48 million, with those by foreigners falling 5.1 percent to 8.46 million and those by domestic tourists tumbling 4.1 percent to 2.02 million.
Overnight stays by German tourists in January fell 4.9 percent to 5.94 million.
